hits.title: Efficient Learning with Partially Observed Attributes
hits.snippet: We describe and analyze efficient algorithms for learning a linear predictor from examples when the learner can only view a few attributes of each training example. hits.title: Location of Single Neuron Memories in a Hebbian Network
hits.snippet: This paper reports the results of an experiment on the use of Kak's B-Matrix approach to spreading activity in a Hebbian neural network. Specifically, it concentrates on the memory retrieval from single neurons and compares the performance of the B-Matrix approach to that of the traditional approach.
